hero.title: What are you actually building?
hero.subtitle: Stress-test your plan before vibe coding. The agent finds every hole, assumption, and unclear decision — and puts every question on one page, each with a recommended answer already selected.
hero.preview: One of the questions your agent will send you — recommended answer pre-selected.

s1.title: Where does this plan break?
s1.body: Vibe coding starts fast. Then the agent makes a decision you never discussed — auth, database, structure — and you find out in the diff.
s1.quote3: One service is enough for now.

s2.title: How does it work?
s2.step1Body: One sentence — “Grill me on my plan to…”. The CLI pushes the questions to the Hub and opens your browser.
s2.step2Body: Every question on one page, recommended answers pre-selected. Change what you disagree with, submit once.
s2.step3Body: Answers return to your agent as structured JSON. New questions? The next round loads in the same tab.

s3.title: How do you want to review your plan?
s3.opt1Label: One at a time, in the terminal
s3.opt1Desc: 10–30 min · answers buried in your scrollback
s3.opt2Label: Don't ask — just write the code
s3.opt2Desc: 0 min · the assumptions surface in the diff
s3.opt3Label: All at once, on one page
s3.opt3Desc: ≤ 5 min · every question with a suggested answer

s4.title: What will you ask me?
